export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_ENTRY_MAX_BYTES: number;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_HISTORY_DEFAULT = 50;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_HISTORY_MAX = 200;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_KEY_PATTERN = "^xs_[0-9a-f]{32}$";

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_LIST_DEFAULT = 50;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_LIST_MAX = 100;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_LOCATION_KEY_PATTERN = "^(?:local:(?:default|[0-9a-f]{24})|connection:[a-z0-9-]{1,100})$";

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_NEXT_STEPS: readonly ["open_scope", "sign_in", "update_tool", "retry", "return_to_tool", "export"];

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_PAGE_MAX_BYTES: number;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_QUERY_MAX_CHARS = 200;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_SCAN_MAX_BYTES: number;

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_REASONS: {
    readonly complete: readonly [];
    readonly reading: readonly [];
    readonly needs_login: readonly ["login_expired", "connection_removed", "account_changed"];
    readonly version_unreadable: readonly ["version_mismatch", "parse_error"];
    readonly failed: readonly ["tool_missing", "timed_out", "read_error"];
    readonly unsupported: readonly ["adapter_pending", "tool_gap"];
    readonly not_allowed: readonly [];
};

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_STATES: readonly ["complete", "reading", "needs_login", "version_unreadable", "failed", "unsupported", "not_allowed"];

export declare const EXTERNAL_SESSION_SUGGESTION_REASON_MAX_CHARS = 120;

export type ExternalSessionActivity = "running" | "idle" | "unknown";

export type ExternalSessionAttribution = {
    state: "confirmed";
    project: ProjectSelection;
    basis: "user_chose" | "suggestion_accepted";
    decided_at: string;
    later_suggestion?: ExternalSessionSuggestion;
} | {
    state: "reported";
    project: ProjectSelection;
    source: {
        kind: "runtime_binding";
        runtime_id: string;
    };
    reported_at: string;
} | {
    state: "automatic";
    project: ProjectSelection;
    evidence: {
        kind: "directory" | "repository";
        path: string;
    };
    tool_reported_other?: {
        project: ProjectSelection;
        runtime_id: string;
    };
} | {
    state: "unfiled";
    reason: "no_relation" | "tool_linked" | "ambiguous" | "relation_gone" | "project_gone" | "left_unfiled";
    candidates: ProjectSelection[];
    suggestion: ExternalSessionSuggestion | null;
};

export interface ExternalSessionConnectionChoice {
    connection_id: string;
    display_name: string;
    account_label: string | null;
}

export type ExternalSessionConnectionRoute = {
    via: "service";
    service_id: string;
} | {
    via: "cli";
    program: string;
};

export type ExternalSessionDirectoryScope = {
    mode: "all";
} | {
    mode: "linked_projects";
};

export interface ExternalSessionDiscoveryRunInput {
    entry_id?: ExternalToolId;
}

export interface ExternalSessionDiscoveryRunOutput {
    queued: ExternalToolId[];
}

export interface ExternalSessionEntry {
    position: string;
    role: ExternalSessionEntryRole;
    at: string | null;
    text: string;
    truncated: boolean;
    step?: {
        name: string;
        status: "ok" | "failed" | "unknown";
    };
}

export type ExternalSessionEntryRole = "you" | "tool" | "tool_step" | "note";

export interface ExternalSessionHistoryInput {
    session_key: string;
    from?: {
        before: string;
    } | {
        after: string;
    } | {
        around: string;
    };
    limit?: number;
    query?: string;
}

export interface ExternalSessionHistoryOutput {
    session_key: string;
    entries: ExternalSessionEntry[];
    older_cursor: string | null;
    newer_cursor: string | null;
    matches: Array<{
        position: string;
        ranges: Array<[number, number]>;
    }>;
    search: {
        scanned_all: boolean;
        next_cursor: string | null;
    } | null;
    read_state: "complete" | "partial";
    stopped: {
        code: string;
        at: string | null;
        retryable: boolean;
    } | null;
    activity: ExternalSessionActivity;
    trust: "untrusted";
}

export interface ExternalSessionIdentity {
    entry_id: ExternalToolId;
    location_key: string;
    native_id: string;
}

export interface ExternalSessionListInput {
    view: "project" | "unfiled" | "all";
    entry_ids?: ExternalToolId[];
    cursor?: string | null;
    limit?: number;
}

export interface ExternalSessionListOutput {
    sessions: Array<ExternalSessionRow | ExternalSessionRowSummary>;
    sources: Array<ExternalSessionSource | ExternalSessionSourceSummary>;
    unfiled_count: number | null;
    next_cursor: string | null;
    scope_revision: number;
    trust: "untrusted";
}

export type ExternalSessionNextStep = (typeof EXTERNAL_SESSION_NEXT_STEPS)[number];

export interface ExternalSessionProjectAiRead {
    project: ProjectSelection;

    allowed: boolean;

}

}

export interface ExternalSessionProjectAiReadSetInput {

}

export interface ExternalSessionProjectCounts {

export interface ExternalSessionReadScope {
    entry_id: ExternalToolId;
    location_key: string;
    allowed: boolean;
    directories: ExternalSessionDirectoryScope;
    connection_id: string | null;
    revision: number;
    decided_at: string;
}

export interface ExternalSessionRow {
    session_key: string;
    identity: ExternalSessionIdentity;
    tool: {
        entry_id: ExternalToolId;
        display_name: string;
        surface: ExternalToolSurface;
        region: ExternalToolRegion;
    };
    seen_via: ExternalToolId[];
    title: string | null;
    directory: string | null;
    last_activity_at: string;
    activity: ExternalSessionActivity;
    attribution: ExternalSessionAttribution;
    forked_from: string | null;
    return_target: {
        kind: "command" | "url";
        label: string;
    } | null;
}

export type ExternalSessionRowSummary = Omit<ExternalSessionRow, "identity" | "return_target"> & {
    return_target: null;
};

export interface ExternalSessionScopeReadInput {
    include_counts?: boolean;
}

export interface ExternalSessionScopeSetInput {
    sources: Array<{
        entry_id: ExternalToolId;
        connection_id?: string;
        allowed: boolean;
        directories: ExternalSessionDirectoryScope;
    }>;
    expected_revision: number;
}

export type ExternalSessionScopeSource = Omit<ExternalSessionReadScope, "location_key" | "decided_at"> & {
    location_key: string | null;
    decided_at: string | null;
    display_name: string;
    adapter: "available" | "none";
    connections: ExternalSessionConnectionChoice[];
    connect_service_id: string | null;
};

export interface ExternalSessionScopeView {
    sources: ExternalSessionScopeSource[];
    project_ai_reads: ExternalSessionProjectAiRead[];
    scope_revision: number;
}

export type ExternalSessionSource = ExternalSessionSourceSummary & {
    location_key: string | null;
    skipped_count: number;
    progress: {
        read: number;
        total: number | null;
    } | null;
};

export type ExternalSessionSourceReason = (typeof EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_REASONS)[ExternalSessionSourceState][number];

export type ExternalSessionSourceState = (typeof EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_STATES)[number];

export type ExternalSessionSourceStatus = {
    [State in ExternalSessionSourceState]: {
        state: State;
        reason: (typeof EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_REASONS)[State][number] extends never ? null : (typeof EXTERNAL_SESSION_SOURCE_REASONS)[State][number];
    };
}[ExternalSessionSourceState];

export type ExternalSessionSourceSummary = ExternalSessionSourceStatus & {
    entry_id: ExternalToolId;
    display_name: string;
    session_count: number;
    completed_at: string | null;
    next_step: ExternalSessionNextStep | null;
};

export interface ExternalSessionSuggestion {
    status: "ready" | "no_match" | "failed";
    project: ProjectSelection | null;
    alternatives: ProjectSelection[];
    reason: string;
    evidence: Array<{
        kind: "directory" | "title" | "message";
        text: string;
    }>;
    created_at: string;
}
